descriptions.title: Description
items: As part of frontend team, I worked on improving performance of housing PWA. This was achieved by following enhancements:
Migrated to React 16 from version 15. ==50% win for `renderToString` completion time==.
Migrated to NodeJS version 8 from version 6 gave ==another 50% win== for above.

workExperience.summary: Revamped Samsung Internet’s Chrome extension, built a Gaana music app for Tizen phones, and helped train Bixby for browser commands.

descriptions.title: Description
items: **[Samsung Internet PC Extension](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/samsung-internet/epejdmjgfibjaffbmojllapapjejipkh "target=_blank;rel=noopener noreferrer")** Starting June 2016: Revamped the extension codebase by switching to modern JavaScript paradigms, UI overhaul and performance optimizations. Successfully shipped version 2.0 in March which received great response (chrome web store rating increased from ==2.7 to 3.7== post launch).
Improved bookmark sync and added ==dynamic loading for collections with 20,000 bookmarks==, with caching and indexing to support browsing, searching, and favoriting.
Added loading bars and other perceived loading indicators to make bookmark sync and browsing feel more responsive.
Userbase increased from ==8,000 to 60,000 monthly active users (~8x)== within 4 months of 2.0 release.

**[Gaana Web App](https://www.tizenexperts.com/2017/06/galaxy-update-samsung-z2-z3-brings-samsung-z4-galaxy-app-features/ "target=_blank;rel=noopener noreferrer")** Starting March 2017: Designed and developed the web application in ReactJS + Redux + [Styled-Components](https://github.com/styled-components/styled-components "target=_blank;rel=noopener noreferrer") (later replaced with [Emotion](https://github.com/tkstrong4/emotion "target=_blank;rel=noopener noreferrer") for perf wins).
Built the ==Gaana music experience as a web app for Tizen phones==, as part of bringing third-party apps to the platform.
Challenges like performance on low end devices, inter-op between Tizen APIs and Web Platform were tackled along with the team.
Successfully launched ==first phase of app within MyGalaxy on Tizen== in Late May.

**[Samsung Internet](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sec.android.app.sbrowser "target=_blank;rel=noopener noreferrer") - [Bixby](http://www.samsung.com/global/galaxy/apps/bixby/ "target=_blank;rel=noopener noreferrer")** April 2017 to July 2017: Wrote JSGF gram files for Samsung Internet domain. \[[video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k2IM_wHrSQ8 "target=_blank;rel=noopener noreferrer")\]
Helped train Bixby for Samsung Internet by writing ==voice commands and browser intents==, so it could understand requests such as opening a particular website from their context.
Helped in bringing ==accuracy to 95%+== for Bixby US launch.

achievements: **==Employee of the Month (December 2016)==** Awarded as Employee of the Month for supporting and developing Samsung Internet PC Extension v2.0 in HQ.

**==Samsung Citizen Award (March 2017)==** *"Though a fresher and new to product development, \[he\] took up one of the key components of Samsung Internet browser, viz Samsung Internet Extension for Chrome and commercialized it flawlessly. All through the project, \[he\] has displayed enormous passion with a clear goal of making it much better."*

education.name: NSIT
education.subtitle:
Netaji Subhas Institute of Technology
Computer Engineering · 2012–2016
facts: **79.48%**, fifth in a department of around 190 students. Consistently in the top ten, with a merit scholarship for all four years.
Mentored a class of 30 in web development and design at IEEE NSIT, and worked on database watermarking research under Assistant Professor Vidhi Khanduja.

Projects included [MVP Generator](https://github.com/bogas04/mvp-generator), [CollNet](https://github.com/bogas04/collnet), [CloudKeeper](https://github.com/bogas04/cloudkeeper), and the [Student Attendance System](https://github.com/bogas04/Attendance-System). I also wrote a [report on rapes](/Rapes.pdf).
Web developer at [IEEE NSIT](//ieeensit.org), core member at [Junoon](//junoonnsit.com), the photography club, and tech head at [CollegeSpace](//collegespace.in).
story: I spent my awkward teenage years at NSIT feeling a little lost and figuring out my place in the world. I kept finding myself thinking, “this is not me”, and asking who I really was. I’m still figuring that out.

One thing I did figure out was the complicated maths behind our grades, with different credits for each subject. A friend and I built [NSITUlator](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZU_RGEo2tsM "target=_blank;rel=noopener noreferrer") to make it easier. It was the first time I felt like an engineer: we saw a problem, made a naive solution, improved it with feedback, and tied it to CollegeSpace so people could use it. Internships, project ideas, and a calling as a web developer followed.
I made some friends along the way, though most of us are now scattered around the world.

education.name:
St. Mary’s
School
education.subtitle: 2002–2012 · CBSE
facts: **95.2%** in Class 12, topping the science stream. Scored **9.8 CGPA** (approximately 93.1%) in Class 10.
Received a merit scholarship for three years, from Class 10 through Class 12.
story: St. Mary’s had a huge impact on my formative years. A lot of my values, and my emphasis on critical thinking, can be traced back to school.

Although it was a Christian school, I loved how open it was to different religions. I never felt like an outsider. Teachers helped me build intuition instead of simply learning by rote. I especially miss Shalini ma’am, whose progressive view of the world inspired me to think more critically and be more tolerant, even when the society around me was more orthodox.
I was delighted to find out I had topped the science stream in the board exams, and even more delighted to see my name in the newspaper!
